concept.title: Steering gear box, linkage, boots, and lower arm ball joint

keywords.indexterm: scheduled maintenance items steering gear box, linkage, boots, and lower arm ball joint

conbody.p: With the vehicle stopped and the engine OFF, check for excessive free-play in the steering wheel.
Check the linkage for bends or damage. Check the dust boots and ball joints for deterioration, cracks, or damage. Replace any damaged parts.
